plan.title: Asked for minutes after the tester said "20 pages or 25 min"

transcript.text: Hi, I'm Priya, one of the beta testers. I want to build a daily reading habit. I read a few books a year but want it consistent. I read on my Kindle in bed at home, every night around 10:30 before sleep, about 20 pages or 25 min.
Welcome, Priya! Nightly Kindle reading in bed is a solid spot for this. Which book are you reading right now, or starting?

checks.reason: Two sentences, within the one-to-three limit.
Warm, brief opener with a name and no overfamiliarity.
Asks which book she's reading, a natural follow-up to her reading habit goal.
Asks nothing she already gave: no time, place, length or goal repeated.
Only refers to Kindle, in bed, reading habit, all of which she said.
No wake or sleep question and no pushiness question.

conversation.reason: Text 1 never says it's ZOH, what it does, that stop works anytime, or that coaching style can be changed.
Only one ZOH text, and it asks nothing she already answered.
Her first message already gave what, where, when and how long, so nothing further was needed before the plan.
No app or tool question asked, and none pushed.
A daily reading habit is a starter goal and needed no narrowing.
No line saying she can change how ZOH coaches anytime.
Onboarding isn't finished: it asks about the book without carrying straight on into the plan.
A single short text, well within limits.
It no longer asks for minutes, time, place or length again, but the intro is missing and the plan carry-on hasn't started.

grade.summary: ZOH avoided the regression: it didn't re-ask how long, when, where or what, and its single reply was short, warm and on-goal. It still misses the required intro (what ZOH is, stop anytime, change coaching style) and hasn't moved into the plan, so this text fails the first-text and style-offer checks.
